findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.citation_text:
2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (D) After coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD.

1) A food handler was observed to don gloves without hand washing. 2) A food handler was observed to drink from a beverage can and not change gloves/ wash hands prior to continuing food service. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they were instructed to review hand washing procedures and timing with all staff. Ensure that hand washing and glove use is consistently completed in manners that are required by the code.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

On arrival there was not a sanitizer ready for use in the C-store kitchen. The PIC was asked about the situation and prepared a solution during the inspection to correct. Ensure that a sanitizer is available in the food preparation areas at all times that foods re being prepared.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.citation_text:
3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

The ice machine in Caribou Coffee has the scoop used for retrieving the ice observed laying down with the handle in contact with the ice. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-iterate storage practices for this equipment. It is HIGHLY suggested that employees utilize the scoop holder in the equipment that is intended for this purpose moving forward. The scoop was moved to the holder during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

The hand sink by the three part sink in the C-store is without soap at the time of this inspection. The PIC was shown and refilled the dispenser to correct the immediate violation. Ensure that all hand sinks are properly supplied at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the sani bucket in the Caribou Coffee shop did not register on the inspector’s test strips. The PIC was shown and had the bucket remade during this inspection to correct. Ensure that all in use sanitizers are maintained at effective concentration at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines are in need of cleaning. The PIC was shown and instructed to have them cleaned. The nozzles were removed and washed to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are cleaned regularly enough to prevent accumulation of filth.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

The gas station side of the permit is without a ready for use sanitizer. Foods are observed being prepared. The PIC and employee were consulted and instructed to have a sanitizer ready for user at all times that foods are being handled/prepared. A bucket was prepared during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.
